_howToEdit: Prices are in euros and include VAT (vatRate is used only if Stripe Tax isn't set up). Change a price here; nothing else needs editing. cohortDays: how long one cohort's access lasts. extendDays: how long an extension lasts, counted from the member's first join. year: the price for a cohort plus a full year, offered at payment (extending later costs the extension price).
